title: Top Tablets Worth Buying This Holiday Season (2026)
summary: The iPad and Samsung Galaxy Tab lines lead the tablet picks from the main review sites this year.
method: Picks come from Tom's Guide (via AOL), TechRadar, Tech Advisor and Consumer Reports' tablet testing. Only models covered by at least two of these sources are listed.
assumptions: We show no prices because tablet prices change often. Check the current price and storage size before you buy.

products.name: Apple iPad (A16)
why: TechRadar calls the latest 11-inch iPad its best budget iPad. Tom's Guide says iPadOS still has the best app library and richest feature set for tablets.
Consumer Reports includes the iPad A16 among its top tested tablets.
cons: Not as powerful as the Air or Pro
products.skip_if: You need pro-level power or a laminated, higher-end display

products.name: Apple iPad Air (M4)
why: Tech Advisor reviewed the 2026 iPad Air and found more power with the same formula. Justbuy calls the 11-inch Air a light yet powerful everyday tablet.
Parse's roundup of AI answers also names the iPad Air for overall balance.
specs: Newer chip than the base iPad
pros: More power than the base iPad
cons: Costs more than the base iPad
products.best_for: People who want a step up without paying Pro prices

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S11
why: Tech Advisor calls the Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra the ultimate Android tablet, and Consumer Reports features the Galaxy Tab S11 in its top picks.
Justbuy says the Tab S11 is built for people who work on the go and want the most from the display.
specs: Ultra version is the biggest and priciest
cons: Android tablet apps are weaker than iPad apps
products.best_for: Android fans who want a premium tablet
products.skip_if: You want the biggest tablet app library

products.name: Apple iPad Pro (M5)
why: Tom's Guide says the iPad Pro M5 has possibly the best screen it has ever seen and is the first iPad with fast charging, but is overkill for most people.
Tech Advisor's review says the best comes at a cost.
specs: First iPad with fast charging (Tom's Guide)
products.best_for: Creators and pros who want the best iPad
products.skip_if: You just read, browse and stream
